description:
Get the details of a face detection task. 

Use this API to get the list of faces detected in the image or video to use in the [face swap photo](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/image-projects/face-swap-photo) or [face swap video](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/face-swap-video) API calls for multi-face swaps.

id.description: The id of the task. This value is returned by the [face detection API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/face-detection#response-id).

name: face_detection_retrieve_details

credits_charged.description: The credits charged for the task.

faces.description: The faces detected in the image or video. The list is populated as faces are detected.

path.description: The path to the face image. This should be used in face swap photo/video API calls as `.assets.face_mappings.original_face`

url.description: The url to the face image. This is used to render the image in your applications.

id.description: The id of the task. This value is returned by the [face detection API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/face-detection#response-id).
